paragraphs.source_en: As the saying goes, sweet barley often brews bitter wine, and happiness often turns into sorrow. Later, Tsangyang Gyatso discovered that Dawa Zhuoma had not come to the Dragon King Pool for many days. He sent word asking to meet her, but, like tsampa scattered into water, there was no reply. When he went in person to visit her lodging, he saw only a large lock hanging on the door. After asking the neighbors, he learned that Dawa Zhuoma had been taken back to Chonggye by her parents many days before. Tsangyang Gyatso felt as though he had lost a beloved treasure, and his heart was filled with grief. Distraught and dispirited, in his anguish he composed the song mentioned earlier, “Do Not Speak Again of Chonggye, Chonggye.” From then on, Tsangyang Gyatso never saw Dawa Zhuoma again; she became the beloved who lived only in his dreams.

She thought of him by day and thought of him by night, while Tsangyang Gyatso too often met her in his dreams. paragraphs.source_en: According to the meaning of this poem, people believed that the Sixth Dalai Lama was very likely to have been reborn in the Litang region. They went to Litang, and after many kinds of verification, found an intelligent, well-favored boy. Later the boy was invited to the Potala Palace for enthronement; he was the Seventh Dalai Lama, Kelzang Gyatso. Although Kelzang Gyatso was born in Litang, his father, Losang Dargye, had deep ties with Chonggye. Losang Dargye was born in the Gyantse area and had been a lama at Riude Monastery in Chonggye since childhood. Later, after clashing with the monastery’s headman, he fled Chonggye overnight to avoid persecution and ran to Lhasa, where he became a servant to a great living Buddha at Drepung Monastery. Once, while driving a caravan of pack animals to Litang in Sichuan Province, he saw a person drifting downstream in a river. When he rescued the person and looked, it was a young woman. The woman was the daughter of a nearby household; while wading across the river, she had carelessly been swept away by the current. Her family was deeply grateful and decided to give the girl to him as his wife. Losang Dargye was delighted; after finishing his affairs, he married the girl and settled down in Litang. Before long they had a child, who was Kelzang Gyatso, later to become the Seventh Dalai Lama.

paragraphs.source_zh: 根据这首诗歌的意思，人们认为六世达赖很可能在理塘地方转世，他们去了理塘，通过多方面验证，找到了一个聪明富态的男孩，后来这个男孩被迎请到布达拉宫坐床，他就是七世达赖喇嘛格桑嘉措。格桑嘉措虽然出生在理塘，可是他的父亲罗桑达吉跟琼结有很深的关系。罗桑达吉出生在江孜地方，从小在琼结日乌德寺当喇嘛，后来和寺庙头人发生冲撞，为免遭迫害，他连夜逃出琼结跑到拉萨，到哲蚌寺给一个大活佛当佣人。有一次他赶马帮到了四川省的理塘，在一条河边看见从上游漂下一个人，他救起来一看，是一位年轻女子。这女子是附近一户人家的女儿，淌水过河时不小心被水冲走了。这家人非常感谢，决定将姑娘嫁给他为妻，罗桑达吉十分高兴，将事情办完以后，遂和姑娘完婚，在理塘定居下来。不久他们就有了一个孩子，就是后来成了七世达赖的格桑嘉措。

paragraphs.source_en: Losang Dargye had originally been a poor lama, but overnight he became the father of a Buddha and came to possess status and wealth. After living for some time in the Potala Palace in Lhasa, he returned to Chonggye and proposed building a new Maitreya Jampa Buddha hall at Riude Monastery, with a gilded bronze statue of Maitreya Jampa two persons tall. People talked about it from every side. Some said he wanted to thank the local deities of Chonggye for blessing him with a child who became the Dalai Lama; others said he wanted to show himself off before the headmen of Riude Monastery. By this time Dawa Zhuoma was already old, but because everyone knew of her relationship with the Sixth Dalai Lama, she was greatly respected and loved by the people. Before the consecration of the Buddha image, Losang Dargye made a special visit to Dawa Zhuoma and sincerely invited her to attend the consecration ceremony. Grateful for the Buddha-father’s kindness, on the day of the consecration she made a special offering to the image: a seven-colored apron she had carefully woven with her own hands. This apron was placed inside the statue as a sacred object.

paragraphs.source_zh: 罗桑达吉本是个穷喇嘛，一夜之间成了佛父，拥有了地位和财富。在拉萨布达拉宫住了一些日子，他又回到琼结，提出要在日乌德寺新修一座弥勒强巴佛殿，塑一尊两人高的弥勒强巴佛镏金铜像。人们议论纷纷，有的说他是要感谢琼结地方的神灵，保佑他生了一个当达赖的孩子；也有人说他是为了在日乌德寺的头人面前显示一下自己。这时候，达娃卓玛虽然已经老了，但因为她和六世达赖喇嘛的关系人人皆知，很受人们的尊重和爱戴。佛像开光之前，罗桑达吉专程前去拜会了达娃卓玛，并诚恳地请她参加佛像的开光仪式，达娃卓玛感谢佛父的盛情，开光那天，她专门为佛像供奉了一条自己精心编织的七彩围裙，这条围裙被作为圣物装藏在佛像里面。

paragraphs.source_en: In the blink of an eye two hundred years passed. During the “Cultural Revolution,” a group of people stormed into Riude Monastery to rebel. They destroyed the Jampa Buddha hall and toppled the Jampa Buddha image. A mule-and-horse trader named Luorewa, when no one was watching, secretly took from the belly of the Jampa Buddha the apron Dawa Zhuoma had offered, its colors still bright, tucked it into his bosom, and carried it home. Beaming with delight, he told his wife to put it on. Unexpectedly, as soon as she tied on the apron, she felt the sky and earth spin, and hurriedly took it off. Later several other people tried wearing it, but the result was the same. Having no other choice, Luorewa had to send the apron back to its original place.

paragraphs.source_en: After the Fifth Dalai Lama passed into parinirvana, Tsangyang Gyatso, still in his mother’s womb, was vaguely and unknowingly recognized as the reincarnated child. How could he at that time have known what this meant, much less understood the struggle for power that surrounded him? His parents could not have imagined either that their son, after becoming the august Sixth Dalai Lama, would end up the pitiful victim of a power struggle between the Tibetan regent, Desi Sangye Gyatso, and Lhazang Khan of the Khoshut Mongols. At that time, the Khoshut Mongols were settled in Qinghai’s Qaidam region and ruled Qinghai and parts of Tibet.

paragraphs.source_en: Originally, while the Fifth Dalai Lama was alive, the struggles between Bon and the Yellow Hat sect, and between the Red Hat sect and the Yellow Hat sect, were extremely fierce. To save itself, the Yellow Hat sect had the Fifth Dalai Lama and the Fourth Panchen Lama together seek aid from the Oirat Mongols in the Xinjiang region. Güshi Khan, leader of the Khoshut, one of the four Oirat divisions, agreed to the Yellow Hat sect’s request in order to avoid internal conflicts and seek new prospects for development.

units.source_en: To save itself, the Yellow Hat sect had the Fifth Dalai Lama and the Fourth Panchen Lama together seek aid from the Oirat Mongols in the Xinjiang region.

ja.t: のオイラト・モンゴル

units.source_zh: 黄教为了自救，五世达赖与四世班禅一起向新疆地区的卫拉特蒙古部求援。

units.source_en: Güshi Khan, leader of the Khoshut, one of the four Oirat divisions, agreed to the Yellow Hat sect’s request in order to avoid internal conflicts and seek new prospects for development.
units.source_zh: 卫拉特四部之一的和硕特部首领固始汗为避内部矛盾，寻求新的发展，答应了黄教的请求。

paragraphs.source_zh: 原来，五世达赖在世时，苯教与黄教、红教与黄教的斗争十分激烈。黄教为了自救，五世达赖与四世班禅一起向新疆地区的卫拉特蒙古部求援。卫拉特四部之一的和硕特部首领固始汗为避内部矛盾，寻求新的发展，答应了黄教的请求。

paragraphs.source_en: In 1636, the ninth year of Chongzhen, Güshi Khan led troops south into Qinghai, defeated Choghtu Khan, and opened up his own domain in Qaidam, west of Qinghai Lake. In 1639, the twelfth year of Chongzhen, Güshi Khan established a “holy alliance” to protect the Yellow Hat sect. In his first expedition he captured the forces of the Beri chieftain Donyo Dorje and others who supported Bon. In the second expedition, Güshi Khan entered Tibet, overthrew the Tsangpa regime, protector of the Red Hat sect, welcomed the Fifth Dalai Lama to be enthroned at the Potala Palace, and received from the Fifth Dalai Lama the title “Nomun Khan” or Dharma King, as well as the post of assistant to the hierarch. In 1642, the open and hidden struggle between Güshi Khan’s great-grandson of the Khoshut and the Desi came to an end with the Desi’s defeat. In 1643, Lobsang spent two years building his own sacred palace on Potala Hill, on the original site of the palace of the ancient kings of Tibet. In form, the Yellow Hat sect thereby officially became the ruling religion of Tibet’s united religious and political order.

units.source_en: In form, the Yellow Hat sect thereby officially became the ruling religion of Tibet’s united religious and political order.
units.source_zh: 黄教从形式上正式成为西藏政教合一的统治宗教。

paragraphs.source_zh: 一六三六年（崇祯九年），固始汗率兵南下青海，击溃却图汗，在青海湖西的柴达木开辟了自己的天下。一六三九年（崇祯十二年），固始汗成立了一个保护黄教的“圣神同盟”，第一次远征攻破支持苯教的白利土司顿月多吉等。第二次远征固始汗进入西藏，推翻红教的保护者藏巴的政权，迎五世达赖坐床于布达拉宫，获五世达赖所赠的“诺门汗”（法王）称号与主教助理的职位。一六四二年，和硕特部固始汗曾孙与第巴之间的明争暗斗以第巴的失败而告一段落。一六四三年罗卜赞用两年时间在布达拉山上原西藏古代国王宫殿的原址上建立了自己的圣殿。黄教从形式上正式成为西藏政教合一的统治宗教。
